response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS a FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), b1 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS v FROM per), s1 AS (SELECT per.ordersmark, per.a, per.a - b1.v AS m1 FROM per, b1 WHERE per.a > b1.v), b2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS v FROM s1), s2 AS (SELECT s1.a, s1.m1, s1.a - b2.v AS m2 FROM s1, b2 WHERE s1.a > b2.v) SELECT AVG(a) AS avg_fill_size, AVG(m1) AS avg_margin_over_overall, AVG(m2) AS avg_margin_over_group FROM s2
